about.title: About BDA
about.intro: Bangladesh Digital Assistant is a citizen information service that helps you find verified government service information with official citations.
about.mission: To make Bangladesh government service information accessible, transparent, and trustworthy for every citizen.
about.how1: We collect information from official government sources
about.how2: Every answer includes citations and confidence levels
about.how3: We never invent fees, URLs, or procedures
about.disclaimer: BDA provides informational guidance only. Always verify critical details with the relevant government office before taking action.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. This policy explains how Bangladesh Digital Assistant handles your data.
privacy.dataCollectionText: We may store anonymous chat conversations for up to 90 days to improve service quality. Registered users can delete their data at any time.
privacy.documentsText: If you upload documents for analysis, they are automatically deleted within 24 hours.
privacy.noSellingText: Your conversations and personal information are never sold to third parties.
privacy.contactText: For privacy concerns, contact us through the official BDA channels.
